data.text:
LOOK: The Quezon City government releases a traffic advisory for Sunday, Nov. 30, as protesters will gather at the EDSA People Power Monument for the “Trillion Peso March” rally.

A zipper lane will be opened on White Plains Avenue beginning 9 p.m. on Saturday. The road will be closed beginning 6 a.m. on Sunday.

📸 Quezon City Government/Facebook

Simula ngayong Nov. 29 hanggang December 1, ay pansamantalang sinuspinde ng Philippine National Police ang permit to carry firearms sa mga pampublikong lugar sa Metro Manila. Ito'y kaugnay ng nakatakdang "Trillion Peso March' protest bukas, Nov. 30.

https://t.co/hSuvHOZvYc

data.text: There are times when I do miss my ad agency days. The way we worked as a team during big pitches, brainstorming ideas, and getting passionate about campaigns. I always loved presenting. I remember, I was the youngest team lead and member of the official pitch team for a big client. In the room with our CEO and regional bosses. We practiced over and over, every move was calculated from the way I should move my hand to the direction I should walk to trigger something psychological. But then I remember, the endless overtimes and Manila traffic. 🤣🤣🤣 Yep, I'm good in my lil consulting bubble.
